test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven students A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting in their classroom facing in the southern direction. A and D do not sit together. Z sits second to the left of X. B does not sit with Z. X is fourth to the right of C. A and B are not sitting together. C sits in between D and Y. Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B. Who sits at the extreme ends?
solution:
Given: Seven students A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting in their classroom facing in the southern direction.

1) Z sits second to the left of X.

2) X is fourth to the right of C.

3) C sits in between D and Y.

4) Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B.

5) B does not sit with Z and A and B are not sitting together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fe4552da1eb9ae4c689db97371550582814c72defec849bba7659cb68582349.png] 

A and D do not sit together.

And, A will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b6e138f7e36069a3381b1ed87a47cda2c8c33a0bb36e87ea1da2c257dc51a35.png] 

Here, '**B and D**' sits at the extreme ends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
